purpose: Document official local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Hooghly district sources identify Jangalpara locally. The state land-record portal has plot/mouza maps and record request services; the Know Your Property viewing path is account/OTP gated and asks for property selectors and identifiers. No credentials or property information were entered and no anonymous vector geometry endpoint was found.
registryAssessment: The official Hooghly district health directory lists Jangalpara PHC, tying the locality to Hooghly. West Bengal’s official Banglarbhumi portal provides plot/RoR and plot/mouza-map services; its interface requires login for citizen map requests, and the official UDMA Know Your Property procedure requires OTP registration and block/mouza/plot selection. No anonymous parcel geometry service was identified.
